function.name: search_stays
function.description: Search the internet for accommodation options in a city available between the requested dates. Return up to 50 candidates with building IDs, listing prices, and sources.

function.name: call_accommodation
function.description: Initiate an outbound call through ElevenLabs Conversational AI to request a quote for an accommodation. Handle call completion and retrieve the transcript when available.

building_id.description: Unique ID of the accommodation being contacted.

phone_number.description: Verified phone number in international format.

function.name: extract_lowest_quote
function.description: Compare accommodation call transcripts and identify the lowest valid, comparable total price for the requested stay. Return the company name, quoted price, currency, and supporting transcript evidence.

transcripts.description: Call transcripts and associated accommodation details.

company_name.description: Name of the company that was called.

call_status.description: Call status, such as completed, failed, or no_answer.

function.name: send_quote_email
function.description: Generate and send an email to the configured recipient summarizing the cheapest accommodation quote. Include the quoted price, organization name, organization address, call transcript link, and reservation number.

price.description: Total quoted price for the entire stay, not the nightly rate.

organization_name.description: Name of the organization that provided the lowest accommodation quote.

organization_address.description: Physical address of the organization or accommodation.

call_transcript_link.description: URL linking to the call transcript that contains the quoted price.

reservation_number.description: Reservation or booking reference number provided by the organization, if available.

function.name: download_lowest_price_conversation
function.description: Download the audio recording for the ElevenLabs conversation associated with the lowest-price accommodation quote. Save the audio locally and return the file path.

conversation_id.description: The ElevenLabs conversation ID associated with the lowest-price accommodation quote.

output_dir.description: Directory where the audio recording should be saved. Defaults to recordings.
